readings.title: FLIP: A Difference Evaluator for Alternating Images
Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to SSIM

success_criteria.description: paper_exact has 24 checksum-verified Kodak images; a subset must be labelled course_fast.
PSNR, windowed SSIM, FLIP, LPIPS, and spectral metric versions are recorded per image.

readings.title: Random-Access Neural Compression of Material Textures

success_criteria.description: Every map has provider, asset ID, license, dimensions, color-space/normal convention, and checksum evidence.
A local proxy is labelled proxy and is not called RTXNTC-equivalent without official parity evidence.

Recompute Table 2 under a different map-category mix before comparing against the paper. The reported PSNR is a map-weighted mean, the eight categories span about 19 dB, and the methods are not equally strong on each, so reweighting changes both the level and the order. Report which method pairs swap. A comparison that skips this step is not a result.

readings.title: Local Positional Encoding for Multi-Layer Perceptrons

success_criteria.description: Lucy, Thai Statue, and Armadillo have source and checksum receipts for derived 512-cubed volumes; Pitted Stonefish remains an explicit authorization blocker until legitimately acquired, with no substitute.
Loss, sign convention, axis order, sampling, seeds, and per-instance IoU are explicit.

readings.title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference

success_criteria.description: Encoded bits include every parameter, scale, zero-point or metadata field used by the scheme.
Multi-seed observations are separated from untested causal explanations.
success_criteria.evidence: run manifest, raw rows, and limitations paragraph

success_criteria.description: The fixture and PyTorch reference agree before an optional HIP binary is used.
GPU evidence names ISA, ROCm version, command, workload, warmup, repetitions, and parity tolerance; unavailable hardware is a documented skip.
success_criteria.evidence: hardware receipt or explicit skip reason

success_criteria.description: Latency comes from a card that was spun up until the shader clock stopped climbing, then measured in interleaved rounds with a rotating start order. The worst round-to-round spread is reported and is under 1.10x. A single back-to-back sweep is not accepted: on this repository that protocol inflated the first method measured by 5.7x and invented a method ordering.
success_criteria.evidence: python hip/stable_latency.py --binary <build> --out <receipt>; receipt fields protocol.method_order and stable

success_criteria.description: State the toolchain the binary was actually built against and how the include order was established, not the version the machine advertises. A host can carry two ROCm installs at once.
success_criteria.evidence: hip/build_kernel.sh header and the recorded compile line

readings.title: RDNA 4 Instruction Set Architecture Reference Guide

success_criteria.description: fp16 and integer reference kernels pass finite and exactness/tolerance checks on CPU.
No comparison to the paper is made unless the complete fused workload, output size, precision, and timing method match.

Derive workgroups per compute unit three ways -- from the LDS footprint, from wave slots, and from the register budget -- and name which one binds. A number copied from a tool without the derivation does not pass.
success_criteria.evidence: python hip/occupancy.py; receipt field limits.limiter with all three workgroups_per_cu_by_* values

success_criteria.description: Close one measure-diagnose-change-remeasure cycle against the limiting resource. Required: the code object footprint before and after, output checksums shown unchanged, the speedup measured under the settled protocol, and a statement of what generality the change cost. Reporting a speedup without the checksum check does not pass.
State the occupancy improvement the arithmetic predicts before measuring, then report the observed speedup and account for the difference. The return on occupancy is expected to be sublinear.

weeks.topic_zh: 專題提案與已驗證基線

success_criteria.description: Track, hypothesis, profile, metric, baseline value, seed, and evidence path are nonblank and finite where numeric.
The baseline is rerun under the selected profile rather than copied from a legacy CSV.

Any run that changes config or tracked source happens in a disposable clone, so the committed tree stays clean and earlier evidence keeps matching the files it cites. Name the clone that produced each number.
A run expected to last more than a few hours declares a liveness check that lives outside the run and asserts progress, not process existence: a monotone counter compared against wall-clock time.

readings.title: Good Enough Practices in Scientific Computing

success_criteria.description: Baseline and extension rows are finite and nonblank; notebook, CSV, slide, run manifest, and limitations all exist.
The conclusion follows the measured result, including a null or negative result.
success_criteria.evidence: limitations and conclusion fields in the submission manifest

success_criteria.description: A claim contradicted by later evidence is retracted in place, not deleted. The wrong claim, the evidence that overturned it, and the corrected statement all remain visible, and a check confirms the retracted wording survives nowhere else.
